summary: Records a grant from IBM that allows conditional free use of one of its patents in connection with the Photuris key management protocol. It is a legal notice rather than a technical document.

eli5.summary: A company wrote down that others may use one of its inventions for free under certain conditions.

subtitle: A public record of IBM's patent license for key management

tldr.problem: The IETF needed to know whether IBM's patents would block adoption of the Photuris key management protocol.
tldr.mechanism: IBM publicly granted a free license to use U.S. patent 5,148,479 for any implementation of Photuris over IP, with one condition: the license terminates if anyone asserts a patent against IBM for IBM's use of Photuris.
tldr.outcome: The grant removed a barrier to adoption but tied both parties to the specific protocol terms.

today: This RFC is Informational and has never been updated or obsoleted. It stands as a historical record of IBM's patent grant.

sections.title: What This Document Is
sections.content:
RFC 1822 is not a technical specification; it is a legal notice. It records a public grant from IBM Corporation, allowing anyone to use IBM U.S. Patent 5,148,479 without paying royalties, provided they implement the Photuris key management protocol and comply with its terms.

The purpose is to remove a patent obstacle to Internet adoption of Photuris, which IBM had contributed to the IETF as a key negotiation method.
sections.eli5: IBM wrote down that anyone could use one of its inventions for free, as long as they use it the right way.

sections.title: The Grant and Its Conditions
sections.content:
IBM covenants not to assert patent 5,148,479 against anyone who implements Photuris or a derivative that includes IBM's contribution and operates in compliance with the protocol. This applies to Photuris over any Internet Protocol.

The grant has one termination clause: it ceases for any party that asserts a patent of its own (directly or indirectly) against IBM for IBM's implementation of Photuris. The termination date is when that patent assertion occurs.

A written license confirmation from IBM is optional; the grant itself, published in this RFC, constitutes the permission.
sections.eli5: IBM promises: use our invention for free as long as you use it right and don't sue us about it.

sections.title: Status Today
sections.content:
Photuris was an early proposal for Internet key management. This patent grant was important in 1995 for lowering legal barriers to its adoption. Later, other key management protocols like IKE became standard. The patent-licensing landscape around encryption has evolved significantly since 1995.

For historical context, this RFC documents IBM's early contribution to the IETF and the free-license model for foundational Internet protocols.
sections.eli5: This note showed that big companies could help the Internet grow by agreeing not to charge money for their inventions.
